headline.title: This startup’s new mechanistic interpretability tool lets you debug LLMs
headline.summary: Goodfire, a San Francisco-based startup, has launched a new mechanistic interpretability tool called Silico, which allows researchers and engineers to examine and adjust the parameters of AI models during training. This tool aims to provide greater control over the behavior of large language models than previously available methods.

articles.title: Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
articles.summary: Researchers are exploring the integration of AI co-clinicians to enhance healthcare delivery and improve patient outcomes. This initiative aims to develop AI systems that can assist healthcare professionals in clinical decision-making and patient management.

articles.title: All the evidence unveiled so far in Musk v. Altman
articles.summary: The Musk v. Altman trial is currently revealing evidence, including email exchanges, photos, and corporate documents from the early days of OpenAI. Key insights and details about the case are emerging as the trial progresses.

articles.title: After dissing Anthropic for limiting Mythos, OpenAI restricts access to Cyber, too
articles.summary: OpenAI is set to restrict access to its cybersecurity testing tool, GPT-5.5 Cyber, initially making it available only to critical cyber defenders. This move follows previous criticism of Anthropic for limiting access to its own AI tool, Mythos.

articles.title: Elon Musk confirms xAI used OpenAI’s models to train Grok
articles.summary: Elon Musk testified in a California federal courtroom that his AI startup, xAI, utilized OpenAI's models to enhance its own Grok system. The case revolves around the practice of model distillation, where larger AI models serve as a "teacher" to smaller models.

articles.title: OpenAI announces new advanced security for ChatGPT accounts, including a partnership with Yubico
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced enhanced security measures for ChatGPT accounts, offering additional opt-in protections. This initiative includes a partnership with Yubico to provide security keys for improved account safety.

articles.title: FDA approval, fundraising, and the reality of building in healthcare according to BioticsAI founder
articles.summary: BioticsAI CEO Robhy Bustami discussed the challenges of operating in the highly regulated healthcare sector during an interview on Build Mode, highlighting the company's strategies for navigating regulatory hurdles and maintaining team motivation. The conversation also touched on the importance of FDA approval and fundraising in the development of healthcare technologies.

articles.title: Google’s Gemini AI assistant is hitting the road in millions of vehicles
articles.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant will be integrated into millions of vehicles, enhancing the driving experience with advanced conversational AI capabilities. This initiative reflects Google's commitment to advancing AI technology in automotive applications.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman Kicks Off, DOJ Guts Voting Rights Unit, and Is the AI Job Apocalypse Overhyped?
articles.summary: The ongoing trial between Elon Musk and Sam Altman is set to have significant repercussions for OpenAI and the broader AI industry, as it delves into their rivalry. Additionally, the episode discusses the recent dismantling of the DOJ's Voting Rights Unit and questions surrounding the potential overhyping of an AI job apocalypse.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are currently engaged in a court battle that could significantly impact OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT. Musk's lawsuit, filed in 2024, alleges that OpenAI has deviated from its original mission of prioritizing humanity's benefit in AI development in favor of profit maximization.

articles.title: Meta is running get-rich-quick ads for its AI tools
articles.summary: Meta's AI company Manus is promoting ads that suggest users can quickly profit by using AI to create websites for local businesses lacking an online presence. The campaign includes compensating content creators to generate promotional material for this initiative.

articles.title: Stripe introduces Link, a digital wallet that autonomous AI agents can use, too
articles.summary: Stripe has launched Link, a digital wallet that allows users to connect their cards, banks, and subscriptions while enabling autonomous AI agents to make secure transactions through approval flows. This new feature aims to streamline payments for both users and AI applications.
